title: People who help us
examples: Who helps us when we are sick?
Can you name some helpers in our town?

explain.say: Today you will learn about people who help us.
Doctors help us when we are sick.
Nurses look after us when we are sick or hurt.
Firefighters help when there is a fire.
Police officers help keep everyone safe.
Vets help animals when they are sick.

faq.q: Who helps us when we are sick?
faq.a: Doctors and nurses help us when we are sick. They give us medicine and check us over.
asks: Who do I go to when I feel unwell?

faq.a: Firefighters use big hoses to put out fires and keep us safe from smoke.
asks: What do they bring to a fire?

faq.a: Police officers help keep everyone safe. If you get lost, stay where you are and ask a police officer or a shop worker for help.
asks: Is the police only for bad guys?

faq.a: Vets are doctors for animals. Doctors and nurses help people.
Some helpers wear uniforms, but some, like a doctor, might wear different clothes.
asks: Do all helpers wear special clothes?

facts: Doctors help people when they are sick.
Firefighters use hoses to put out fires.
Police officers help keep the community safe.

quiz.say: Who sprays water to put out a fire?
quiz.why: Firefighters use hoses and water to put out fires.

wrong.1: Police officers help keep people safe on the roads and streets.
wrong.2: Nurses look after people who are sick or hurt.

quiz.say: A dog is sick. Who can help the dog?
quiz.why: A vet is a doctor for animals.

wrong.0: A doctor helps people, and a vet helps animals.

quiz.say: Who helps keep people safe on the streets?
quiz.why: Police officers help keep everyone safe.

wrong.1: Nurses look after people who are sick.
